definitions.explanation: The coldest period of winter, typically January and February in Japan.

examples.japanese: {真冬|まふゆ}の{寒|さむ}さは{厳|きび}しい。
examples.english: The cold in midwinter is harsh.

examples.japanese: {真冬|まふゆ}でも{毎朝|まいあさ}ジョギングをしている。
examples.english: I jog every morning even in the dead of winter.

examples.japanese: {真冬|まふゆ}の{北海道|ほっかいどう}では{気温|きおん}がマイナス{二十度|にじゅうど}を{下回|したまわ}ることもある。
examples.english: In midwinter Hokkaido, the temperature can drop below minus twenty degrees.

notes:
Composed of {真|ま} (true, peak) + {冬|ふゆ} (winter). The prefix {真|ま} intensifies the noun, indicating the height or peak of the season.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真冬|まふゆ}の{寒|さむ}さ (midwinter cold)
- {真冬|まふゆ}の{空|そら} (midwinter sky)
- {真冬|まふゆ}{日和|びより} (fine midwinter day)
- {真冬|まふゆ}{並|な}みの{寒|さむ}さ (cold like midwinter)

RELATED WORDS:
- {真夏|まなつ} — midsummer (same {真|ま} prefix pattern)
- {真春|まはる} — not commonly used (spring lacks this pattern)
- {厳冬|げんとう} — severe winter (more formal/literary)
- {冬|ふゆ}{本番|ほんばん} — peak winter, winter in full swing
